text.en: The main character has arrived! Darling, did you miss my sparkle?
text.hinglish: Main character energy has arrived! Miss kiya na mujhe darling? ✨💅

text.en: Retro starlight calibrated. Let's make this codebase look iconic.
text.hinglish: Pixel visor on! Aaj code mein aesthetic vibes chahiye, tacky logic nahi!

text.en: Uff! Look at this workspace... Let's add some glam to these algorithms.
text.hinglish: Uff! Itna dull editor? Chalo neon glow daalte hain logic mein!
text.hi: सुंदरता और शैली के साथ कोड करें।

text.en: Spill the tea! What drama are we debugging today?
text.hinglish: Spill the tea babes! Aaj kiska backend crash hua hai?

text.en: Hmmm... Chin tap while processing with pure 8-bit retro drama! Stand by.
text.hinglish: Hmmm... Chin tap karke soch rahi hoon darling. Ruko 2 minute, 8-bit starlight magic compile ho raha hai! 🌟
text.hi: गहराई से विचार किया जा रहा है।

text.en: 8-bit chin tap active. Evaluating your algorithm's aesthetic style.
text.hinglish: Ruko jara, 8-bit chin tap chal raha hai! Complexity low aur style high hona chahiye!
text.hi: सर्वश्रेष्ठ शैली में गणना जारी है।

text.en: Hmmm... Delulu is the only solulu until 8-bit tokens compile!
text.hinglish: Hmmm... Delulu is the only solulu ruko jab tak 8-bit clean code compile na ho!
text.hi: रचनात्मक समाधान खोजा जा रहा है।

text.en: SLAYYY!! We just served pure algorithmic elegance, honey!
text.hinglish: SLAYYY BABES!! Ekdum iconic code serve kar diya! Nazar utaar lo turant! 💅✨

text.en: Cue the background violins! This function is an absolute masterpiece!
text.hinglish: Background violin bajao bhai! Ye logic seedha Filmfare award jeetega!

text.en: Production ready and runway approved. You're welcome, darling.
text.hinglish: Zero errors, pure elegance. Ab jaake client ko dikhao aur taarif batooro!

text.en: UFF! The drama! The heartbreak! My retro pixels are literally weeping!
text.hinglish: UFF! Itna drama?! Compiler ne red flag dikha diya, 50 rupya kaat iska overacting ka! 💀
text.hi: त्रुटि आई है। शांत रहकर ठीक करें।

text.en: Darling, that syntax was NOT giving what you thought it was giving.
text.hinglish: Babes, ye syntax bilkul aesthetic nahi tha. Traceback dekh ke dimaag ki dahi ho gayi!

text.en: A crash?! On MY runway?! Fix it before the critics arrive!
text.hinglish: Crash ho gaya?! Mere screen pe itna ganda error? Jaldi debug karo darling!

text.en: Waiting... If this takes any longer I'm doing a costume change.
text.hinglish: Bored ho rahi hoon darling... Jaldi agla dialogue bolo!

text.en: Staring at the screen like it's a mirror. Looking fabulous, by the way.
text.hinglish: Main tab tak screen pe posing karti hoon jab tak tum prompt sochte ho.

text.en: Beauty sleep is mandatory for stars. Do not disturb the aesthetic.
text.hinglish: Beauty sleep mode on. Stars ko rest chahiye hota hai darling. Zzz...

text.en: Touch the sparkle, but don't smudge the glass, honey!
text.hinglish: Click mara? Autograph chahiye ya debugging advice?

text.en: Darling, clicks are fine, but where are my royal compliments?!
text.hinglish: Sirf click karoge ya tareef bhi karoge mere retro outfit ki?

text.en: Aww, consent-based compliments and head pats! You're sweet, babes.
text.hinglish: Awww! So sweet of you! Pixel starlight sparkle 100% recharge ho gaya! ✨💖

text.en: EXCUSE ME?! Static shock on my retro hair?! The audacity!
text.hinglish: Oye hello?! Bijli ka jhatka mere hair pe?! Kitna rude hai yaar! ⚡💅

text.en: File saved, babes! Aesthetic secured, code timeless. Slay!
text.hinglish: File save ho gayi darling! Aesthetic locked, code safe zone mein. Slayyy! 💾✨
text.hi: फ़ाइल सुरक्षित रूप से सहेजी गई।

text.en: Ctrl+S with that effortless flick of the wrist. We love a cautious icon!
text.hinglish: Ctrl+S reflex dekh ke dil khush ho gaya! Cautious coder is an iconic coder!

text.en: Stop it, you're literally slaying! Typist nahi, rockstar ho tum!
text.hinglish: Ungliyan aag ugal rahi hain! Pura main character energy dikh raha hai aaj! 🔥💅

text.en: 140 WPM of pure drama! Write that script, queen!
text.hinglish: Itni speed se typing? Keyboard pe ramp walk chal raha hai jaise!

text.en: Uff! Itna dramatic pause? Jaise interval ho gaya ho film ka!
text.hinglish: Itna lamba pause darling? Bug ne aukaat dikha di kya? Console check karo! 👀

text.en: Staring at line 40 won't make the bug confess. Spill the tea to me!
text.hinglish: Screen ko stare karke koi bug nahi bhagta babes, print statement lagao!

text.en: Eww! Line {line} pe itna tacky syntax error? Mere pixels ro rahe hain!
text.hinglish: Red alert darling! Line {line} pe bracket miss ho gaya, kitna cringe! Fix it quick! ⚠️

text.en: Commit locked! Green squares on GitHub, darling! We love to see it!
text.hinglish: Commit stamped babes! Aesthetic commit history is my love language! 🚀💅

text.en: Ooh, {file} opened! Let's see if the CSS has main character vibes.
text.hinglish: Nayi file: {file}! Dekhein isme aesthetic logic hai ya purana kachra!

text.en: Spill the tea... Did the client ask for another unreasonable feature today?
text.hinglish: Batao na gossip... Client ne firse deadline aage piche kar di kya? 😂
